title: CSB Organises Programme on Quantum Technologies and Post-Quantum Security
summary: Cyber Security Brunei (the national cyber security agency) press release announcing the first Quantum Technology and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Workshop, co-hosted with Malaysia's NACSA and PTPKM, attended by national agencies, regulators and banks to assess Brunei Darussalam's readiness on post-quantum cryptography and align national effort towards PQC migration.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Migration Framework
summary: Cyber Security Brunei's national framework for moving Government agencies, Critical Information Infrastructure Owners and private-sector organisations to quantum-safe cryptography, citing the harvest now, decrypt later risk to RSA and ECC. It sets a five-phase risk-based migration strategy (Assess, Select, Validate, Deploy, Monitor), with vulnerable algorithms deprecated by 2030 and full migration completed by 2035.

title: Cyber Security Brunei Announces the Return of STACK 2026
summary: Cyber Security Brunei press release dated 5 June 2026 announcing STACK 2026, a three-day conference held 8-10 June 2026. One programme highlight is a consultation session, "Brunei's Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Migration Framework", that introduces CSB's national roadmap for the transition to quantum-resistant cryptography. Stakeholders from government, critical information infrastructure sectors and academia are invited to take part.
